newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan overnight rates remain at high level.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan overnight rates remain at high level.

text.p: Pakistani money market overnight rates remained at high levels on Friday owing to a shortage of funds in the banking system, dealers said.

Heavy amounts were traded at 19.50 percent and some at even 20 percent, one dealer at KASB & Co said. The market depicted a short picture at the close as some banks were seen shopping for funds until the close.
The market remained short for the second day, the dealer said. -- Ibrahim Khan 9221-5685192
